# Complete Markdown Preview Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Render every syntax generated by the formatting toolbar in both live preview and PDF export.

**Architecture:** Extend the existing synchronous `markdown-it` renderer with focused plugins for KaTeX, footnotes, task lists, and marks. Represent Mermaid fences as escaped source placeholders and enhance them asynchronously with a dynamically imported strict-mode Mermaid renderer shared by live preview and PDF export.

**Tech Stack:** TypeScript, markdown-it, @mdit plugins, KaTeX, Mermaid, DOM APIs, Node test runner, Vite.

---

### Task 1: Extended Markdown regression tests

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/markdownExtensions.test.ts`
- Modify: `tests/previewLinks.test.ts`

- [ ] Add tests asserting that `$x^2$` and `$$x^2$$` produce KaTeX markup.
- [ ] Add tests asserting that footnotes produce references and a footnote section.
- [ ] Add tests asserting that task lists produce disabled checkboxes.
- [ ] Add tests asserting that `==text==` produces a `mark` element.
- [ ] Add a test asserting that existing external-link attributes and source-line anchors remain present.
- [ ] Run `npm.cmd test -- tests/markdownExtensions.test.ts tests/previewLinks.test.ts`.
- [ ] Confirm the new extension assertions fail because the plugins are not installed or registered.
